lead_raw_text:
The structure of SrZnCl₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with a 20-atom unit cell (Sr₄Zn₄Cl₁₂) distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Zn centers in octahedral coordination by six Cl neighbors, while Sr centers adopt a close-packed-like 12-neighbor arrangement with Cl. The Zn octahedra share corners and edges with one another and corners with Sr 12-vertex polyhedra, forming a three-dimensional connectivity network. No property labels were supplied for this description.
